gloss: sound quality; tone quality; audio quality

definitions.gloss: sound quality; tone quality; audio quality
definitions.explanation: The quality or character of sound, especially as reproduced by audio equipment. Also used for the inherent tonal quality of musical instruments or voices.

examples.japanese: このヘッドホンは{音質|おんしつ}がいい。
examples.english: These headphones have good sound quality.

examples.japanese: {音質|おんしつ}を{調整|ちょうせい}する{設定|せってい}はどこですか。
examples.english: Where is the setting to adjust the sound quality?

examples.japanese: {値段|ねだん}は{安|やす}いが、{音質|おんしつ}は{期待|きたい}していたよりずっと{良|よ}かった。
examples.english: The price was cheap, but the sound quality was much better than I expected.

notes:
Composed of {音|おん} (sound) + {質|しつ} (quality). Very commonly used when discussing audio equipment, music streaming, recordings, and musical instruments.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {音質|おんしつ}がいい/{悪|わる}い: good/bad sound quality
- {高|こう}{音質|おんしつ}: high sound quality
- {音質|おんしつ}を{調整|ちょうせい}する: to adjust sound quality
- {音質|おんしつ}にこだわる: to be particular about sound quality
- {音質|おんしつ}{向上|こうじょう}: improvement in sound quality

RELATED WORDS:
- {画質|がしつ}: image/picture quality
- {音量|おんりょう}: volume (loudness)
- {音色|ねいろ}: tone color/timbre — the character of a sound, especially in music
